# Gn035 — Circle translated to NURBS form with rational weights but missing weight metadata

## Sources
- OCCT MANTIS#0006542

## Description

A circle is converted to a NURBS representation when exporting to a format that does not natively support analytic curves. The NURBS expression of a circle requires rational weights (control-point weights of `(1, 1/√2, 1, 1/√2, 1, ...)`); writer emits weights but forgets to mark the curve `RATIONAL_B_SPLINE_CURVE`. Reader treats it as uniform-weight, producing a polygonal approximation instead of an exact circle.

## Reproducer recipe

B-spline curve, degree 2, 9 control points, knots `(0,0,0, 0.25,0.25, 0.5,0.5, 0.75,0.75, 1,1,1)`, weights `(1, √2/2, 1, √2/2, 1, √2/2, 1, √2/2, 1)`. Missing `RATIONAL_B_SPLINE_CURVE` complex-entity marker.

## Expected kernel behavior

every B-spline with non-uniform weights must be tagged `RATIONAL_B_SPLINE_CURVE` (complex entity); receivers check the tag before applying weights.
